reasonToInvestigate: The development-selected configuration was positive in all 12 historical window/scenario runs and in continuous-account diagnostics, while failing episode and drawdown requirements.

signal.entryBandMeaning: turnover control, not predicted net return

observationRequirements: Freeze source and configuration hashes before the first newly collected decision.
Use only completed native daily candles with explicit availability times and gap checks.
Preserve the historical signal-to-execution delays when checking replay-to-observation parity; any different executable timing is a separately labeled experiment.
Persist all decisions and rejections as well as fills; record synchronized executable books, quote age, size limits and both-side fees.
Use fresh product-specific fee evidence when available; preserve conservative public-tier scenarios separately.
Maintain one funded position or cash with no leverage, additions or automatic size increases.
Keep any changed sizing or hard risk limits a separate candidate with an explicit replay and execution contract.
Measure cash and funded passive BTC/ETH benchmarks on matching dates; a weekly-rule comparison needs native weekly history and clearly identified timing differences.
Reconcile cash plus net liquidation inventory to marked P&L, distinguishing strategy exits from terminal valuation.
Retain known historical failures and count all future variants; do not reset accumulated losses or change the nominee after seeing later outcomes.

reviewProtocol.duration: Six calendar months after the actual collector start timestamp, recorded before collection begins.
reviewProtocol.sparseSampleResult: INCONCLUSIVE; no automatic promotion or claim of dependable profitability.
reviewProtocol.evaluation: Report fee-inclusive return, passive excess, full-account drawdown, concentration, timing/fill failures and uncertainty; positive nominal net alone is insufficient.
reviewProtocol.drawdownIssue: Historical continuous sampled drawdown reached $752.57 on $10,000 starting cash. The candidate is not a demonstrated fit for a 5% drawdown objective.
reviewProtocol.implementationDependencies: A separate forward collector and reviewed execution/accounting adapter remain to be implemented before this specification can collect evidence.
